title: Preserve operator monitoring interruption when a declared background task settles
outcome: A later declared artifact settlement preserves an operator's monitoring-interruption state and diagnostic.
acceptance: Record the intended interaction between monitoring_interrupted_at and a later declared task completion, and preserve the operator interruption flag and detail according to that contract.

A deterministic regression interrupts monitoring on an open declared background row, delivers the original task completion with a valid artifact, and checks the observable state, interruption flag and diagnostic; existing ordinary completion remains covered.
